clips.title: The story
paras: Above Ratchet's docks, Brewmaster Drohn tends his brewing craft. The orc lives just uphill from the port, making potent drinks with methods tied to the wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout. Travelers who find discarded kegs across Kalimdor are sent to Drohn's porch.

Brewmaster Drohn brews from his home on the hill above Ratchet's goblin docks. Rather than devote himself to combat, the orc has given his craft to brewing. He lives peacefully in the neutral haven established by Gazlowe's Steamwheedle cartel. While many orcs favor coarse grog or simple spirits, Drohn works with rare ingredients, carefully balanced flavors, and methods seldom practiced among his kin.

Brewmaster Drohn learned brewing through a mentor who studied under Chen Stormstout, the pandaren wanderer who fought beside Rexxar and the Horde during the founding of Durotar. Chen also taught Drohn to make Trogg Ale. When travelers find Chen's discarded kegs in the wilds, Drohn is the only local authority who can identify their ingredients and recreate the wanderer's potent brews.
